description: List the transitive outgoing dependencies of a node, BFS to depth N (default 3, max 10). Each result carries distance, edge type, and provenance — both static (EXTRACTED) and runtime (OBSERVED). Pass depth=1 for direct-only.

depth.description: BFS depth (default 3, max 10). depth=1 returns direct dependencies only.

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_dependencies
